notes: Complete TIC-80 3D raycast FPS Wolf-80, inspired by Wolfenstein 3D but with original low-res TIC-80 pixel art (not official Wolf3D assets). Playable cart wolf-80.tic (md5 39bed0f878c8e12546524ea175d67b56); gameplay source in game.lua (md5 8e4aec38f9d6c6803f933da9e2658abd) and renderer in raycast.lua (md5 14ef4d4e9d711e33233f4f848410dc01). MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2021 Wojciech Graj; git blob 3fa19ac2b7121c12aeaaaaf9377eb7e927ce66b0). Features weapons, two enemy types, pickups, minimap, and line-of-sight AI. README notes planned music & SFX were not added; no bundled TTF/OTF, no EXE/DLL/LFS. Author screenshots retained (scr1.png md5 089945d51103d0aa1ace851d965c963b, scr2.png 9567736faf0cd760a05fa0fe7f89fbce, scr3.png d504f93886dea53cb090963c2c2faf0e) plus original texture/HUD reference images (textures.png, hud.png, enemy.png, half-height.png). Omitted three non-redistributable Lode Vandevenne raycasting-tutorial diagrams (screenshots/raycasthit.png md5 2d6379a582efd67c10be8fb5f97bd14c, raycastdelta.png md5 1671411281843d0b739039a301d11173, raycastperpwalldist.png md5 68582889051f583fdef90e3d6848461e): they are copyright 2004–2007 Lode Vandevenne, All rights reserved, and may not be copied without permission (https://lodev.org/cgtutor/legal.html). README may still link to the original tutorial. Playable online: https://tic80.com/play?cart=2333. Upstream repo is archived; snapshot is the default-branch tip. ~960K src snapshot. Claim #4149.
